name: Legends of Maraudon
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
A dark satyr called Lord Vyletongue spread his evil through these twisting caves, poisoning the minds of all inside. He still resides beyond the purple crystals.

Vyletongue also created a living symbol of his corruption called Noxxion that dwells beyond the orange crystals. Together, they have stolen the two parts of my brother's scepter. Celebras, my brother... he wanders blindly inside, cursed by corruption.

You must help him! Find the pieces, and speak to my brother... somehow.
narrative.objectives:
Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.

Find a way to speak with Celebras.
narrative.offerRewardText: Now that you have recovered the two parts of my scepter, I have hope that Maraudon may one day be rid of the Vyle corruption.
narrative.requestItemsText: I have awoken from a nightmare that seemed it would never end...

chain.subtitle: 2 quests at level 49, 9,100 XP in all.

quests.name: Legends of Maraudon
quests.objectiveText: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond. Find a way to speak with Celebras.

quests.name: The Scepter of Celebras
quests.objectiveText: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras. Speak with him when the ritual is complete.
